system.description: Risky. You barrel through the crowd like a runaway brewer's dray. Move up to 40'. Choose up to three foes that come within your reach along the way, then test Agility (DR18) once for all of them. On a success, each takes 3d6 damage and, your choice for each, is knocked Prone or pushed 10'.

outcomes.ruin: You go down with them: your movement ends beside the first foe, and you are Prone.
